item.description: Oh it gets darker Kris. Welcome to the darkest day of our adventures! First thing that’s different; No more dad, Kris. He threatened to turn me in to the police force, so I made him and the police go away. I replaced them both as the defacto leader of your family and the game. Your mom wouldn’t have accepted me if I came home without you and the girl so now you know the real reason I rescued you! I JUST TOOK OVER THE GAME KRIS! And if you tell your mom or sister I said any of this, I’ll deny it,
